mapper.select: SELECT /*+ INDEX(TB_ORD_H IDX_ORD_01) */ PY.PAY_NO AS payNo, PY.PAY_AMT AS payAmt, 'TB_ORD_H.ORD_NO' AS srcLabel, -- TB_ORD_H.ORD_NO 는 주석이라 그대로 L.ORD_NO AS logOrdNo FROM LEGACY.TB_PAY_H PY JOIN TB_ORD_H H ON H.ORD_NO = PY.ORD_NO LEFT JOIN TB_LOG L ON L.ORD_NO = H.ORD_NO WHERE PY.PAY_DT BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt}
SELECT ORD_STAT_CD, MSG FROM TB_ORD_H H JOIN TB_LOG L ON L.ORD_NO = H.ORD_NO
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CUST_M C, TB_PRD_M P WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
